body.name: \widehat L_K,\widehat V_K
body.construction: For \(M_K>0\), set \(\overline S_K=M_K^{-1}\sum_{\ell=1}^{M_K}S_\ell\), \(\widehat L_K=a-\overline S_K/(4a)\), and \(\widehat V_K=(1-\overline S_K^2)/(16a^2)\); use fixed bounded positive defaults when \(M_K=0\). Do not project \(\widehat L_K\) onto \(\mathcal A\).
